Under preview1, Y has no clone or copy call, so all 512 MiB must pass through fd_read and fd_write. Each costs at least 67.1 ms at native 8 GB/s, and wasip1 is single-threaded. Floor L = max(134.2/4, 67.1) = 67.1 ms. ln(67.1/4.81) = 2.64, which exceeds b = 0.236, so the gap is architectural."}
